business_problem: CRRC needed an industrial large-model environment and a faster approach to aerodynamic simulation so it could carry out the state-owned-enterprise 'AI plus industry' mandate without the time and compute overhead of traditional simulation tools.
solution_summary: CRRC used Baidu AI Cloud to build two connected industrial-AI layers. First, Baidu delivered a one-stop enterprise large-model solution adapted to CRRC's domestic GPU environment, dedicated container cloud and MaaS interfaces. That gave CRRC access to language, image, computer-vision and multimodal model services for tasks such as agent development, visual analysis, quality inspection and design support. Second, the two sides created the 'Zhuolun Fengchi' aerodynamic-simulation large model for high-speed train development. Instead of treating simulation as a purely numerical batch job, the new design combines a data-driven simulation model, an efficient compute framework and application tools so engineers can change shapes and get feedback almost immediately. The platform therefore serves both general industrial-AI use cases and one deeply vertical engineering workload, giving CRRC a shared industrial model layer plus a breakthrough application in train aerodynamics.
